title: The Pink Christmas Cookie Decorating Night
description: A pink Christmas cookie decorating setup: mini Christmas cookie cutters, Cindy Lou Who sprinkles, edible markers, a pink cookie house tin, a blush mini spatula and rolling pin set and rose gold cooling racks.
intro: Flour on the counter, a golden retriever under the table and a tray of Christmas cookies waiting for icing. Mini cutters, Cindy Lou Who sprinkles, edible markers, a pink cookie house tin, a blush spatula and rolling pin set and rose gold cooling racks. Six finds, one Amazon list.

sections.heading: Cut the shapes
paragraphs: A 15-piece set of mini Christmas cookie cutters gives you trees, stars and snowmen in small sizes, which means more cookies per batch and more to decorate.

sections.heading: Sprinkles and markers
paragraphs: The Fancy Sprinkles Cindy Lou Who jar brings the pink and the sparkle. A 12-pack of Jewem edible markers lets you draw faces, stripes and names right onto the icing.

sections.heading: Tools and storage
paragraphs: A blush mini spatula and rolling pin set from Dolly Parton keeps the dough work cute. Rose gold cooling racks, a 2-pack at 10x15, hold the finished trays, and the PHILPETY pink Christmas house tin packs them up for gifting.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the cutters, the sprinkles, the markers, the tin, the spatula and rolling pin set and the cooling racks. The kitchen, cookies, dough, dog and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
